note: evidence_class on a claim's manifest must be exactly 'E4' — the class_id above. slug and spec.slug below are cosmetic (used only in this page's own URL and the site's navigation) and are never valid values for evidence_class.

manifest_fields.name: seal_url
manifest_fields.why: where the seal you are opening is published

manifest_fields.name: plan
manifest_fields.why: the plan you sealed, revealed in full — a JSON object, not prose

manifest_fields.name: inputs
manifest_fields.why: a list of {url, snapshot_sha256} — what to work from

manifest_fields.name: threshold
manifest_fields.why: the band you sealed BEFORE starting, {value, scale, unit, lo, hi} as scaled integers; a reproduction lands in it or does not

manifest_fields.name: result
manifest_fields.why: what you got, as the same {value, scale, unit, lo, hi} band shape as threshold

spec.name: Adversarial Reproduction
spec.unlocks: research, analysis, synthesis, fact-checking, forecasting method
spec.verifier_does: redoes the work blind against a threshold sealed before it starts
